Carrier Check Notice

Travelers using Aurelia Skyways should bring their pet carrier to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for a quick check before travel. It helps us make sure each carrier is safe, tidy, and ready for the cabin or hold, depending on the booking.

Our trained staff give every animal patient attention while they look over the latch, base, air flow, and fit. If anything needs a small fix, we will point it out in simple words so you can sort it out without stress. Bringing your own soft bedding and a familiar toy can also help your pet settle in more easily.

Please keep your carrier easy to reach when you arrive, and bring any papers that go with your pet. If you are unsure about a carrier or want a fresh check after a last-minute change, our desk can help.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you head onward.
